description: This file declares the WebAudioPlayerService class, which implements the IWebAudioPlayerService interface. It manages WebAudioPlayer instances, providing methods to create, destroy, control playback, and query buffer and device info. It also includes necessary headers and uses synchronization primitives for thread safety.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerService
classes.description: A class that manages WebAudioPlayer instances, providing creation, control, and cleanup functionalities for web audio playback.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Creates a new WebAudioPlayer instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: destroyWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Destroys the WebAudioPlayer associated with the given handle.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts playback on the specified WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses playback on the specified WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Sets end-of-stream for the specified WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves the available buffer frames and shared memory info for the specified player.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Retrieves the current buffer delay in frames.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes audio data to the buffer of the specified WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device info such as preferred and maximum frames, and support for deferred play.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume for the specified WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Retrieves the current volume of the specified WebAudioPlayer.
